empty.label: No Project
empty.title: Add a Project to start
empty.description: Argo shows the Sessions, Tickets and Atlas of one Project. Choose its folder to begin.

folder.title: Choose a Project folder
folder.description: Choose the Project folder. Argo will find Targets inside it.

method.title: 1 · Choose a setup method
method.description: Ask an agent to find Targets and recommend setup, or define Target commands without changing Project files.
method.defaultReady: {{harness}} is the default Harness. It is ready.
method.defaultRequired: Choose a default Harness before Argo analyzes the Project.
method.skipNote: You can open this Project now and finish setup later.

agent.title: Set up with an agent
agent.subtitle: A Harness is the app that Argo uses to run an agent.

manual.title: Manual setup
manual.subtitle: Preview Target JSON without changing Project files.

defaultHarness.title: Choose your default Harness
defaultHarness.description: Choose the Harness to use in this setup preview.
defaultHarness.label: Default Harness

harness.title: Choose the setup agent
harness.description: Argo will start a short-lived agent that plans setup for this Project. It will not write files during planning.
harness.label: Harness
harness.note: The agent can read Project files. Argo applies changes in a separate phase that you start later.

analyzing.title: 2 · Analyze the Project
analyzing.description: The setup agent builds a plan. It does not write files, install dependencies, or run Project commands yet.

recommendations.title: 3 · Targets and tools
recommendations.description: The agent found {{targets}} without changing the Project.

customize.title: Customize Targets and setup actions
customize.description: Keep only the Targets that matter. Each Target owns its path, commands, tools, dependencies, and verification.

planInput.title: Choose the main Project folder
planInput.description: The agent stopped before producing plan data because two Project folders look runnable.
planInput.question: Use packages as independent Targets?
planInput.note: Your answer updates the plan. Argo did not apply any changes.

cannotPlan.title: Setup needs another route
cannotPlan.description: The agent could not find a supported manifest or a safe command source. No partial plan is shown.

invalidPlan.title: The plan could not be read safely
invalidPlan.description: Argo rejected the agent response at the boundary. Targets and recommendations are hidden so partial data cannot be applied.

projectSetup.title: 4 · Customize Project setup
projectSetup.description: Choose the Project-wide changes to include in the preview.

apply.title: 5 · Preview apply and verification
apply.description: This preview shows how an agent will apply each accepted change and verify each required Target.
apply.waiting: The preview is waiting for issue tracking and domain documentation choices.

applyFailed.title: Target verification failed
applyFailed.description: {{target}} failed a required task. Fix its setup or retry the failed task before Argo starts this Project.

starting.title: Previewing the Project start
starting.description: The preview completed its required tasks for {{targets}}.

complete.skippedDescription: Setup was skipped. The preview has no required Targets or configuration.
complete.runningDescription: This preview shows the Targets and Project files the agent will prepare.

flow.openProjectUnavailable: Project opening will be connected with setup persistence.

projectFiles.title: Project file changes

harnessSettings.subtitle: Changes a global Harness setting outside this Project.
harnessSettings.title: Harness settings

target.noSuggestions: The agent proposed no changes for this Target.
target.name: Target name
target.suggestedToolsDescription: Choose which tools the agent will add to this Target.

manual.title: Import Target configuration
manual.description: Paste Target definitions for this Project. Argo validates only the JSON structure. It does not inspect or run commands, change files, or install anything.
manual.cardDescription: Empty Targets and commands are allowed.
manual.targetNote: Argo validates only the JSON structure. It did not inspect or run these commands.

status.invalid: Use a JSON object with a targets object. Target fields must be strings.
status.found: {{targets}} found. Empty Targets and commands are allowed.

complete.title: Manual configuration preview
complete.description: The JSON structure is valid. This preview did not save data, inspect commands, or change Project files.
complete.noTargetsDescription: You can add Target definitions later.

setup.invalidJson: Fix JSON syntax before testing the config.
